name: SwitchBot
summary:
SwitchBot develops connected-home devices and embodied home robotics. Its product ecosystem includes retrofit controls, smart locks, curtains, sensors and household robots, bringing sensing and physical action together across the home. The company emphasizes integrating new capabilities into existing living spaces.

Its Omni Sense VLA technology connects visual input, spoken interaction and action, supporting coordination between robots and other devices. This approach treats household assistance as an ecosystem rather than an isolated machine: a robot can interact with appliances and controls while the wider home provides information and context. Its development direction includes more capable multitasking household robots.
